key.label: Pairing code
key.description: Same code on every device. Empty uses the code generated by this PC (shown in the panel).

peers.label: Manual devices
peers.description: ip:port of the phone or Quest, for networks that block automatic discovery or for Tailscale. E.g. 192.168.0.20:47321

alarms.label: Ring alarms on this PC
alarms.description: Notification and sound when an unfinished task is due

alarm_sound.label: Alarm sound
alarm_sound.description: Tone used for alarms on this PC

ring_seconds.label: Alarm length (seconds)
ring_seconds.description: How long the sound repeats. 0 shows only the notification.

sounds.label: Interface sounds
sounds.description: Little sounds when checking tasks, picking a mood, finishing the day and for focus

ui.offline: The SunBi service has not started yet. Enable the plugin in Settings → Plugins.
ui.focus_end_body: Mark it done or start another block.
ui.no_devices: No devices yet. Use the same code in the app (Settings → Sync).
